1322-2105-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1322-2105-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-2105-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1339-2741-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2741-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-6012-6798--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2043-4785-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-4785-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1090-5998-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3151-4644-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Elves.
3151-4644-7791.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Elvish Archdruid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2654-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon
1618-2440-2654-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Shark Typhoon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2654-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

32-112-6496.manaNeeded: {14}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U} minus {1} for each card you exile with Delve the first turn, plus {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
32-112-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
32-112-6496.description:
Cast Temporal Trespass by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Temporal Trespass and exiling the original Temporal Trespass with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Temporal Trespass copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Temporal Trespass and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Temporal Trespass's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Temporal Trespass and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Temporal Trespass's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
32-112-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Temporal Trespass is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Temporal Trespass is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

944-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1642-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1642-5944.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Unstoppable Slasher
Unstoppable Slasher triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
The opponent dealt combat damage loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1170-1329-1492-2059.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-2059.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

618-2921-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1018-1987-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Scrivener.
When Skullwinder and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

147-2171-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-6797.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1062-2657-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-2657-3487-5674.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
When the Bear enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

2440-2703-6791.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2770-3967-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2770-3967-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1991-3750-4214.notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1991-3750-4214.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If Tana has power six or greater, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

466-1107-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
466-1107-2034.description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}.
Activate Saproling Cluster by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Rite of Harmony triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1644-1987-2404-4423.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three other Islands.
You control at least two creatures.
1644-1987-2404-4423.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary.
Gaea's Cradle and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, triggering Tatyova twice and Mystic Sanctuary.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve both Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw two cards and gain two life.
Repeat.

2034-4186-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4186-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2738-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding {C}{C}.
Tenacious Dead dies, causing you to pay {2} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
